items.caption: Steady SA, α 6° · crossflow one chord behind the TE, streamwise vorticity: the tip-vortex core with the trailed sheet feeding it inboard — the CFD version of the Trefftz exhibit above.
URANS SA, α 14° · same plane, instantaneous: stronger core, thicker sheet from the separated flow.
SA-DDES, α 14° · instantaneous. At this wake-mesh resolution the resolved content is modest — the faceting in the core is the mesh talking, and the honest fix is a wake refinement zone.
SA-DDES, α 14° · time-averaged over the last 30 convective times: the mean field the cheaper models are trying to predict.
SA-DDES · five chords back: the sheet has wound up, the core persists and drifts inboard-down — exactly what the vortex-lattice roll-up predicts.
URANS SA, α 14° · inboard section Cp field: stagnation red at the nose, the suction glow above, and instantaneous shedding at the TE. Upstream speckle is slice interpolation on coarse farfield cells.
